# Shopstr Markets

Shopstr Markets operates permissionless marketplaces built on Bitcoin, Nostr, and Cashu. We enable free, censorship-resistant trade without platform fees or restrictions.

## Key Pages

- Homepage: https://shopstrmarkets.com/
- FAQ: https://shopstrmarkets.com/faq
- Privacy Policy: https://shopstrmarkets.com/privacy-policy
- Terms of Service: https://shopstrmarkets.com/terms-of-service

## Live Marketplaces

- Shopstr (https://shopstr.market) — general permissionless marketplace
- Milk Market (https://milk.market) — marketplace for food producers and artisans
